OP-18 pre-orders on eBay

Research and data: OP Box Index · Published September 14, 2026 · Updated October 2, 2026 · Data sources & methodology

Bandai published the OP-18 product pages on both its Japanese and English sites. The eighteenth main booster, 神の支配 / The Dominance of God, releases on November 21, 2026 in Japan and November 20, 2026 in English — across the 22 sets tracked here, the first English date to land ahead of its Japanese one. The set is themed on Water Seven and the Holy Knights of God, and contains 127+1 card types. What is still missing is the full card list, the rarity breakdown and any completed sale, so this page records the confirmed specification and leaves the valuation fields open.

What is confirmed and what is still open

Confirmed on Bandai's own pages: the set code OP-18, both titles (神の支配 and The Dominance of God), the Japanese release date of November 21, 2026, the English release date of November 20, 2026, ¥240 and USD $4.99 per pack, six cards per Japanese pack, 127+1 card types, and the Water Seven / Holy Knights of God theme with Saint Gunko and Saint Shamrock debuting.

Still open: the full card list, the rarity and parallel breakdown, the Japanese display specification, and any completed sale. The 24-pack box count comes from a retailer listing rather than Bandai, so it is labelled that way rather than treated as official.

The Japanese gap from OP-17 (August 22, 2026) to OP-18 is 91 days — the interval that appears in 10 of the 17 Japanese main-set gaps recorded on our set list and release dates page. That is a record of what has already happened, not a method used to produce this date; the date above comes from Bandai.

How the Amazon Japan invite works for OP-18

The OP-18 box is listed under Amazon's invite-based sale: you press the invite-request button on the product page, and Amazon later emails invitations to a subset of requesters. Requesting is free and does not commit you to buy. The step-by-step guide, including what gates overseas delivery, is on the Amazon Japan raffle page, where OP-18 is listed with a direct link.

An open invite request is not proof of delivery. Amazon opened requests before Bandai published the OP-18 page; the box ships only from the release date, November 21, 2026 in Japan.

What OP-17's launch showed

OP-17 The World's Strongest Warriors released in Japan on August 22, 2026 and in English on August 28, 2026, the closest to a simultaneous global release the game has had. Its sealed Japanese box has been tracked from the first completed eBay sale, and that page shows the launch-week price path with sample counts.

One launch is one data point. Print volume, distribution, reprints and the card list all differ between sets, so OP-17's price path is context, not evidence of what OP-18 will do.

Evidence required before a sealed-box valuation

A useful OP-18 valuation needs the official Japanese specification, the confirmed card list and treatments, language-matched completed sales with transaction counts, and a clear seal standard. Active listings show seller expectations and are not substituted for sales. Single-card prices do not translate into sealed-box value until pull rates and hit distribution are known.

Reprint information is reported only when Bandai, distributors, or dated market supply records support it. Absence of a reprint notice is not described as proof that no reprint will occur.

Update policy

Bandai's product page is now published and its facts are recorded above. This page is reviewed again when the card list appears, when Bandai states a box configuration, and when a valid sold-box sample forms after release. Material changes receive a new visible review date. Price, population and reprint fields follow the definitions in our methodology; unavailable values remain unavailable.

Frequently asked questions

When does OP-18 release?

Bandai lists November 21, 2026 for the Japanese release and November 20, 2026 for English. Both official product pages were checked September 28, 2026.

What is OP-18 called?

The Japanese title is 神の支配 (Kami no Shihai); Bandai's English name is BOOSTER PACK -THE DOMINANCE OF GOD-.

Can I pre-order OP-18 now?

Amazon Japan is taking invite requests for the OP-18 booster box (24 packs). Requesting an invite is free; Amazon later invites a subset of requesters to buy, and boxes ship from the November 21 release. See the Amazon Japan raffle page for the steps.

Is there an English OP-18 release date?

Yes. Bandai's English product page lists November 20, 2026 — one day before the Japanese date — at USD $4.99 per pack.

What seal should a Japanese OP-18 box have?

Use the original uncut Bandai security tape as the primary factory-seal check. Added shrink is not a substitute.
